understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete each level by activating and stepping onto all goal cells. A goal cell can only be completed when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time. Completing all goals advances to the next level; running out of all lives ends the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Walls can block movement, leaving you in place but still costing stamina. The carried piece has attributes: shape, color, and rotation (in 90° increments). Stepping on modifier tiles changes one attribute: shape modifiers cycle the piece’s shape, color modifiers cycle its color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. The UI reports when a goal is ACTIVATED (current piece matches it) and you must step onto that goal cell to complete it. Stamina decreases with actions; when stamina reaches 0, the next action causes you to lose a life and stamina resets. The game can also point to specific modifier tile locations needed to fix a mismatch (e.g., needing a rotation changer to return to the required rotation).
